transcription_convention: Selected printed clauses with abbreviations expanded. Ellipses mark omissions.

sigilla-title-authors.normalized_latin: Salomone, Rege Iudaeorum; Raphaele, Chaele, Iudaeis; Hermete, Aegyptio; Thetele, Persa.
sigilla-title-authors.reason: The title gives Solomon’s title in full. In the two-column list the plural Iudaeis groups Raphael and Chael. Aegyptio aligns with Hermes and Persa with Thetel. These are the identifications printed in this witness.
